name: Workshop Foundry AI
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then APT="apt-get"; elif command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then APT="sudo apt-get"; else echo package install requires root or sudo; exit 1; fi; $APT update; if ! command -v sqlcmd >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v bcp >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ ! -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-prod.list ]; then curl -sSL https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc | gpg --dearmor > /tmp/microsoft.gpg && if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then install -o root -g root -m 644 /tmp/microsoft.gpg /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/microsoft.gpg; else sudo install -o root -g root -m 644 /tmp/microsoft.gpg /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/microsoft.gpg; fi && echo "deb [arch=amd64] https://packages.microsoft.com/debian/12/prod bookworm main" | if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-prod.list >/dev/null; else sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/microsoft-prod.list >/dev/null; fi; fi; $APT update; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive ACCEPT_EULA=Y $APT install -y mssql-tools18 unixodbc-dev; if [ -x /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd ] && ! command -v sqlcmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then ln -sf /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd /usr/local/bin/sqlcmd && ln -sf /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/bcp /usr/local/bin/bcp; else sudo ln -sf /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd /usr/local/bin/sqlcmd && sudo ln -sf /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/bcp /usr/local/bin/bcp; fi; fi; fi; python --version && az version && pwsh -v && sqlcmd -? >/dev/null && bcp -v'
